eva_asr.install_policy: Clone the exact commit, verify uv.lock SHA-256, then run uv sync --locked. A plain pip install is not reproducible.

rvm_mobilenetv3.install_policy: Downloaded on first presenter-cutout use, verified by SHA-256 and stored in the user's cache; never include it in Core or template ZIPs.

notes: Pilot lock only; the current Studio Dockerfile is intentionally unchanged.
Production adoption requires ASR fixture and container rebuild approval.
